title: Settings
description: Profile, opening hours, legal notice, languages and ordering of your restaurant.

general.title: General
general.description: This is how your restaurant appears on the digital menu.
general.name: Restaurant name
general.cuisineHint: Short and sweet, e.g. “Italian” or “Kebab & grill”
general.emailError: Please enter a valid email address.
general.websiteError: Please enter a full address starting with https://.

slug.title: Web address of your menu
slug.description: Guests find your menu at this address. The QR codes point exactly here.
slug.label: Address
slug.hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only (3–48 characters).
slug.taken: Sorry, this address is already taken.
slug.invalid: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only (3–48 characters).
slug.warning: Careful: if you change the address, all QR codes you have printed and links you have shared will stop working. Print new QR codes afterwards.
slug.confirmDescription: New address: /m/{to} (previously /m/{from}). Printed QR codes and old links will stop working.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.overnightHint: If a slot ends after midnight (e.g. 18:00–02:00), simply enter it like that.

legal.title: Legal notice (Impressum)
legal.description: Mandatory information guests find via a link on your menu.
legal.why: Under § 5 of the German Digital Services Act (DDG) your online menu needs a legal notice (Impressum). We show these details automatically, together with address, phone and email from “General”.
legal.companyHint: Full name incl. legal form, e.g. “Pizzeria Roma GmbH”
legal.representativeHint: Managing director or owner (first and last name)
legal.registerHint: Only if registered in the commercial register
legal.extraHint: e.g. supervisory authority, chamber or notes on dispute resolution
legal.addressNote: Address, phone and email are maintained above under “General”. This is not legal advice.

languages.title: Languages for guests
languages.description: Choose the languages in which guests can read your menu.
languages.sourceHint: you maintain your menu in it. All other languages are translated from it.
languages.limitReached: Your plan allows {limit} languages (including the source language).
languages.disableHint: If you deselect a language, guests no longer see it. Existing translations stay saved and are back immediately when you re-enable it.

ordering.title: Ordering via the menu
ordering.description: Guests order right at the table – you see everything live on the order board.
ordering.locked: Ordering is included in the Pro plan.
ordering.manualHint: Every order first lands in “New”. Your team checks and accepts it – the guest sees the status live.
ordering.autoHint: Orders count as accepted immediately and go straight to the kitchen. Ideal when things need to be quick.
ordering.requireTable: Only allow orders from table QR codes
ordering.requireTableHint: Recommended: you always know which table the order is for. The general QR code then only shows the menu.
ordering.requireTableNoTables: Your plan does not include table QR codes – turn this off so guests can order via the general QR code.
ordering.allowNotesHint: Guests can add requests like “no onions”.
ordering.kassenHint: Note: orders via VeroMenu are not POS transactions. VeroMenu is not a certified cash register (no TSE under the German KassenSichV). Please record and take payments as usual via your POS.

translations.title: Translation quality
translations.description: Decide how reviewed translations must be before guests see them.
translations.onlyApproved: Only show approved translations to guests
translations.onlyApprovedHint: Texts that have not been reviewed yet are then shown in the source language.
translations.autoApproveHint: Translations our AI review scores at least {value} out of 5 are approved automatically. All others land in your review list.

danger.title: Data & deletion
danger.description: Export your data and delete the restaurant.
danger.exportDescription: All menus, categories, dishes, prices, allergens and translations as a JSON file.
danger.deleteDescription: For security reasons we only delete restaurants on request. Write to {email} – we delete all data within 30 days (Art. 17 GDPR).
